description: This file provides utility functions for handling message formatting in Nextcloud Talk, including markdown conversion, escaping, mention formatting, code formatting, stripping formatting, and text truncation.

methods.name: export function markdownToNextcloudTalk(text: string): string { markdownToNextcloudTalk
methods.description: Converts markdown text to a format compatible with Nextcloud Talk, primarily trims whitespace.

methods.name: export function escapeNextcloudTalkMarkdown(text: string): string { escapeNextcloudTalkMarkdown
methods.description: Escapes special characters in text to prevent markdown interpretation.

methods.name: export function formatNextcloudTalkMention(userId: string): string { formatNextcloudTalkMention
methods.description: Formats a user mention for Nextcloud Talk using the '@user' syntax.

methods.name: export function formatNextcloudTalkCodeBlock(code: string, language?: string): string { formatNextcloudTalkCodeBlock
methods.description: Wraps code in a code block syntax suitable for Nextcloud Talk, with optional language specification.

methods.name: export function formatNextcloudTalkInlineCode(code: string): string { formatNextcloudTalkInlineCode
methods.description: Formats inline code; if the code contains backticks, uses double backticks for delimiting.

methods.name: export function stripNextcloudTalkFormatting(text: string): string { stripNextcloudTalkFormatting
methods.description: Removes various Nextcloud Talk-specific markdown formatting to extract plain text.

methods.name: export function truncateNextcloudTalkText(text: string, maxLength: number, suffix = "..."): stri/ truncateNextcloudTalkText
methods.description: Truncates text to a specified maximum length, attempting to preserve whole words, and appends a suffix if truncated.
